rules.zh: 重绘两个1930年的比较对象。每行25人，红色表示大城市居民，蓝色表示其余居民；每枚对应4个百分点。
rules.en: Redraw two comparison rows from 1930. Each row represents 25 people; red marks large-city residents and blue the remainder. Each icon represents four percentage points.

rules.zh: 按对象｜时期｜分母｜红色数｜推算蓝色数｜图示百分数编排，保留原中文标签。数据记录：{{data_rows}}。
rules.en: Use object, period, denominator, red count, derived blue count and pictorial percentage, in that order. Preserve the Chinese labels. Records: {{data_rows}}.
